question: What is the exact price and delivery date of custom AI for my salon?

response.answer: A possible design would start with a discovery session to define the exact AI features you need for your salon, followed by a proposal that outlines price and timeline. Because custom AI projects are scoped to each business, we can’t give an exact price or delivery date until we agree on the specific requirements, integrations, and any optional services such as the $330 audit or $5 automated report. Once the scope is set, a detailed quote and schedule can be prepared and approved by a human before any work begins.
response.title: Pricing & Timeline for Custom AI in Salons

steps.title: Discovery & Scope Definition
steps.detail: Meet with stakeholders to capture salon needs, AI use‑cases, and integration points.

steps.title: Design & Proposal
steps.detail: Create a solution design, estimate effort, and draft a price and timeline for client review.

steps.title: Human Approval & Agreement
steps.detail: Client reviews and approves the proposal; any audit or report options are confirmed.

steps.title: Development & Testing
steps.detail: Build the AI features, integrate with booking or POS systems, and run QA cycles.

steps.title: Deployment & Training
steps.detail: Launch the solution, provide staff training, and set up monitoring.

blocks.title: Steps to Get an Exact Quote
items: Define the specific AI capabilities you want (e.g., appointment scheduling, client insights).
Identify required integrations (booking software, POS, marketing tools).
Choose whether to include the optional $330 website audit or $5 automated report.
Schedule a discovery call with our team to outline the project scope.
Review the custom proposal with price and delivery timeline before approval.
